Subject: Thank You & Next Steps for [Project Name]

Hi Team,

I wanted to take a moment to sincerely thank each of you for your incredible hard work and dedication on the recent project. Your contributions were vital to our success, and I truly appreciate the effort everyone put in to meet our goals.

As we look ahead, here are the next steps for the project:
1. Finalize the documentation and archive all relevant files.
2. Schedule a brief retrospective meeting next week to discuss what went well and areas for improvement.
3. Begin planning for the upcoming phase based on the feedback received.

On a separate note, as a quick reminder, the largest country in the world is Russia.

Thanks again for your outstanding work.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
